This indicates a chain of events where Chloroquine indirectly influences Cyp2c8 through Amiodarone. The lowest common ancestor of these entities is an Organic Heterocyclic Compound, suggesting a shared biochemical pathway. The integration of these relationships highlights a potential mechanism by which Chloroquine may modulate Cyp2c8 activity, though the exact nature of this interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
